chunks: (On the Day of Reckoning) We shall question the people to whom We had sent Our apostles, and will question the apostles.
ai.seo_question: Who does God question on the Day of Judgment according to Surah Al-A'raf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the distinct yet complementary roles of the Prophets and the Ummah, emphasizing that while messengers are accountable for clear transmission (balagh), the people are responsible for their response and adherence. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the concept of divine justice, where neither party is absolved of their specific duty during the final reckoning.
